 Anchor & Senior Political Analyst 
 Nicolle Wallace is a journalist, author, and the anchor of “Deadline: White House,” airing weeknights at 4 p.m. ET on MS NOW. The program provides in-depth reporting and dynamic discussions on the political stories driving the news cycle, as Wallace brings viewers the latest political developments of the day, in addition to interviews with leading newsmakers and influential politicians. 
Before joining MS NOW full-time, Wallace had a storied career both on-air and in government. She is a former co-host of ABC’s “The View,” and prior to her role anchoring MS NOW’s “Deadline: White House,” Wallace served as a frequent contributor to the network. Wallace continues to serve as an NBC political analyst across NBC Nightly News, TODAY Show and more, and provided in-depth 2016 election reporting and commentary in segments and series, including “In Trump We Trust.” She is a former White House Communications Chief under George W. Bush, and served as a senior advisor for John McCain’s 2008 presidential campaign. 
Wallace is a graduate of the University of California, Berkeley and Northwestern University’s Medill School of Journalism.
